metadata.title: Hessian sectional curvatures of conjugate symmetric statistical manifolds
metadata.abstract: Conjugate symmetric statistical manifolds generalize Hessian manifolds. Shima introduced Hessian sectional curvature in 1995 as an invariant for studying Hessian structures. We extend this invariant to conjugate symmetric statistical manifolds and study related curvature conditions and invariants. Our main results are as follows. For connected Hessian manifolds of dimension at least two, we characterize constant Hessian sectional curvature (CHC) by pointwise orthogonal invariance. We call conjugate symmetric statistical manifolds satisfying this invariance condition weakly CHC. We classify connected weakly CHC statistical manifolds of dimension at least two whose cubic forms are parallel with respect to the Levi-Civita connection. This classification characterizes the non-Hessian statistical structures induced on the classical hyperbolic affine spheres $xyz=c>0$ in the positive octant. We also introduce principal Hessian curvatures and show that they form a complete invariant for left-invariant Hessian structures on $\mathbb{R}^n$ up to statistical isomorphism.
